nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the organizer; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the access-control gate in pickWinner and transferAmount.
Private address storing the selected winner; written in pickWinner and used as the ether recipient in transferAmount.
Private bool flag guarding registration, transferAmount, getWinner and getIsWinnerSelected; set to true in pickWinner.
Private mapping(address => Participant) storing participant name, phone and email keyed by msg.sender.
Private address[] of all registered participants; pushed in registration and read in pickWinner, random and getParticipants.
Caller-controlled address used as mapping key, constructor assignment and organizer comparison in the require statements.
Block timestamp (now) influenced by miners and used together with block.difficulty as the randomness source in random().
Constructor that assigns organizer = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
Payable public function requiring msg.value > .00001 ether and !isWinnerSelected; writes participant data, appends to participantList and forwards funds to organizer via sendAmount.
Public function restricted to organizer; computes index via random() % participantList.length and writes winnerAddress plus isWinnerSelected.
Payable public function restricted to organizer with isWinnerSelected true; forwards msg.value to winnerAddress via sendAmount.
Public view returning the isWinnerSelected flag.
Public view returning the full participantList array.
Public view requiring isWinnerSelected and returning participants[winnerAddress].name.
Public view returning the organizer address.
Private function performing _account.transfer(_amount), an external ETH transfer call.
Private view returning uint(keccak256(block.difficulty, now, participantList)), a predictable on-chain randomness source.
Low-level ETH transfer via _account.transfer(_amount) inside sendAmount; external call target receives value before all logic settles, enabling potential reentrancy.
Use of block.difficulty, now and participantList in keccak256 as randomness; miner-manipulable timestamp/difficulty dependency violating fair winner selection.
Modulo operation random() % participantList.length in pickWinner; no guard for an empty participantList, an arithmetic hazard (division by zero / revert).
String parameter of registration written into participants[msg.sender].name.
String parameter of registration written into participants[msg.sender].phone.
String parameter of registration written into participants[msg.sender].email.
uint parameter of sendAmount used as the value of the external transfer.
address parameter of sendAmount used as the external transfer destination (organizer or winnerAddress).
Local uint in pickWinner computed as random() % participantList.length and used to index participantList.
Storage pointer local in registration referencing participants[msg.sender] before writing participant fields.
